statement: Assign each physical source part to its actual profile and unique vertical integer cell. Aggregate equal-family counts per cell. Every actual occupied band area is at least its independently verified cell minimum, and all filled profile outers are disjoint inside the guarded stock. Hence the sum of floored demand units cannot exceed the floored stock-band area. Three family sums retain every one of the ten mandatory originals. Removing horizontal coordinates, pair collisions and shared within-cell shifts only relaxes feasibility.
scope: Current fixed cog orientation and source stock guard, with all eight bracket and both insert profiles. The three closed prescribed-orientation source models are contained in this necessary family allocation. No raw unrestricted-rotation or H5 acceptance claim.
